result:
Decision is **CONTINUE**: round 253 is a small fix-up for round 252. Round 252 failed on one Low acceptance row and its gate was skipped, so nothing from round 252 was published or closed.

**Why round 252 failed (C-R252-01).** After a ruler click pauses Follow during playback, pressing Stop turns Follow back on. But the status line still reads "…playback continues, Follow paused…". The task contradicted itself: one section said Stop writes no status, while C's acceptance row said the stopped screen must show no Follow text. I took C's plain reading, because round 252 introduced that false sentence.

**Round 253 task (`current-task.md`):**
- **Item 1 (C-R252-01):** when playback stops, a status that is only true during playback is replaced with `Stopped — Space plays from the insert marker at <t>.` There are three such texts: the two "Insert marker at … playback continues" lines and "Follow paused by manual navigation". Every other status is left alone.
- **Item 2:** the same check also fixes an older Low. Without any Follow pause, "playback continues" also stays on screen after Stop; this happens at HEAD too.
- **Item 3:** the paused-Follow tooltip and status now name the real ways to resume: "press Follow, or stop playback".
- **Rows:** the C-NAV-ORIGIN row is rewritten. Its playing case at the project end can only be reached in the unit test, because playback stops itself at the end.
- **Files:** A may edit 6 files: `StudioWorkspace.tsx`, `strings.ts`, three test files and doc 191. The other 7 round-252 files must stay exactly as they are. The 1,097 frozen files and the 7 protected auth/purchase files are untouched.
- **New tests:** each new or amended test row has a named mutant that must turn it red.
- **C's checks:** C re-runs only the changed rows, in the browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720. They include a check that unrelated statuses are not overwritten, and that the export hash still matches round 252.

**Pre-check.** On a scratch copy I applied the candidate fix:
- **Typecheck:** passes.
- **Tests:** 2,408 Studio tests ran and 4 failed, all in files this round owns.
- **Proof of the new behaviour:** the updated Stop test (FW6) passes. So the fix reads the insert marker, not the stop position.

**Backlog and status board:**
- **New findings:** C-R252-01, C-N252-FOLLOW-TITLE and B-R253-STALE-PLAYING-STATUS are added and scheduled for round 253.
- **Still open:** the six round-252 findings stay open until round 253 passes and is published.
- **Deferred:** A-R252-REVIEW-PLAYING-SOURCE moves to the deferred Low list, which now has 414 entries.
- **Architecture note:** the reviewer's `useTimelineFollow` idea is recorded as addendum 4 to the transport architecture signal. It is not scheduled.
- **Board:** `feature-status.md` marks round 252 as a bug and round 253 as in progress.

**Next:**
- **Regression round:** not due today (2 days since the last one). It is due at the next planning, on or after 2026-10-30, and its scope now includes the round-253 checks.
- **If round 253 passes:**
  - SABA-B-10a is finished, and the gate publishes rounds 252 and 253 together.
  - I write the architecture checkpoint request for root.
  - Then come the regression round, SABA-B-10b, SABA-B-9 and SABA-B-11c.

**Advisor:** available, and consulted twice (before writing and before finishing). I followed its advice: the narrow fix, exact-text rows, the hash sets for the uncommitted tree, and three wording fixes. I did not change any app code, and the store still shows exactly the 13 round-252 modified files.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- `current-task.md`
- `tasks/round-252.md` (the archived round-252 task)
- `b-round-252.md`
- `b-next.json`
- `backlog.json`
- `feature-status.md`
- `b-round-252/` (start hashes, pre-check diff and results)
